body:
## Summary

`GetObject` ignores the `Range` header (returns the full object `200`, never `206`) and honors no conditional headers. Range/partial reads back resumable downloads, media streaming, and range-based tools; conditional GET/PUT (`If-Match`/`If-None-Match`/`If-Modified-Since`) back caching and optimistic concurrency.

**Current behavior:** no Range/conditional handling anywhere (`crates/gateway-s3/src/lib.rs:319-338`); no `Accept-Ranges`.

## Scope for Alpha
- Honor `Range: bytes=a-b` → `206 Partial Content` with `Content-Range`, streaming only the requested span from the chunk map; advertise `Accept-Ranges: bytes`.
- Honor `If-None-Match`/`If-Match` (against the object ETag) and `If-Modified-Since`/`If-Unmodified-Since` on GET/HEAD → `304` / `412` as appropriate.

## Acceptance
- `aws s3api get-object --range bytes=0-1023` returns 206 with the correct span; a ranged re-download matches the corresponding bytes.
- Conditional requests return 304/412 correctly.

Depends on: object-metadata/ETag. Part of the 0.1-Alpha S3 completion epic (P1).

milestone.title: 0.1 Alpha
milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.

title: s3: honor Range and conditional GET/HEAD (If-Match/If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since)
